query: What dataset size and stratification targets (n per motion grade, pathology, field-strength, sequence) are needed to power clinically acceptable LV/RV measurement error estimates?

response.query: What dataset size and stratification targets (n per motion grade, pathology, field-strength, sequence) are needed to power clinically acceptable LV/RV measurement error estimates?
response.answer: To power clinically acceptable LV/RV measurement error estimates, a dataset size of at least 300 patients stratified by motion grade, pathology, field-strength, and sequence is needed. Larger sample sizes improve precision.
